name: Sarah (Raguel's daughter)
title: Tobias' wife in the Book of Tobit
summary: Sarah was the daughter of Raguel in Ecbatana. An evil spirit had killed her seven previous husbands on their wedding night, but with the help of the angel Raphael she was freed and married to Tobias.

keyEvents.title: Married to Tobias
keyEvents.description: After the evil spirit was driven out, Sarah married Tobias and followed him home to Tobit.
